heroHeadline: Iran Attack on Saudi Tanker Sidr Kills Two in Strait of Hormuz
heroSubtitle: The Bahri-owned VLCC Sidr was struck by unidentified projectiles on Aug 31 while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, killing two Filipino crew members in one of the deadliest single incidents against Saudi maritime interests since the Iran war began; Saudi Arabia condemned the attack while Iran's IRGC claimed the vessels struck mines. Aramco has responded by routing a growing share of September crude to Asia via ship-to-ship transfers off Fujairah and Sohar to avoid direct Hormuz transits. Separately, Saudi Arabia joined Jordan, the UAE, Egypt, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey and Qatar on Sept 6 in condemning Israeli ministers' calls for the forced displacement of Palestinians from Gaza.
